name: Animated Stars Globe
description: An interactive 3D celestial sphere and 2D planar constellation map built entirely from animated stars with smooth morphing and country telemetry.
longDescription: A unified, ultra-premium celestial component that seamlessly morphs between an interactive 3D spherical globe and a 2D equirectangular planar constellation map. Features interactive pan and drag rotation, country telemetry highlights with pulsing radar beacons, smooth auto-rotation with gesture-resume, curated star color palettes, atmospheric nebula glow, and zero heavy 3D engine overhead using native SVG paths.
features: Seamless bidirectional morphing between 3D spherical globe and 2D planar map
60fps continuous auto-rotation with seamless gesture drag and resume
Country focus telemetry with animated fly-to camera and pulsing radar beacon
Six curated celestial color themes and customizable atmospheric glow
Zero heavy 3D engine dependencies — pure high-performance native SVG vector rendering
Full responsive scaling support via size prop

props.name: initialMode
props.description: Initial display mode (3D globe or 2D flat planar map).

props.name: onModeChange
props.description: Callback triggered when the mode switches between globe and flat.

props.name: allowModeToggle
props.description: Whether to show the segmented mode toggle buttons in the control dock.

props.name: size
props.description: Width and diameter bounding size for the globe and map canvas.

props.name: selectedCountryCode
props.description: ISO country code of the highlighted country (e.g. 'IN', 'US', 'GB').

props.name: onSelectCountry
props.description: Callback invoked when a country is selected.

props.name: autoRotate
props.description: Enable or disable automatic globe rotation.

props.name: showCustomizationControls
props.description: Show or hide the dock with color swatches, mode toggle, and play/pause controls.

usage.title: Basic Usage
usage.description: Render an interactive 3D stars globe that morphs into a 2D flat map with live country radar highlights.

steps: Copy StarsGlobe.tsx and worldData.ts to your components folder
Import StarsGlobe and enjoy the celestial animations
